title: SQL built by concatenation (elixir) — review required
description: A elixir query call assembles SQL from parts: (?:Ecto.Adapters.SQL|Repo).query!?s*((?:[^()]|([^()]*))*<>. If any part is untrusted input, the query structure itself is attacker-controlled. This lexical rule flags the assembly; the reviewer confirms every part is trusted or parameterizes it.
remediation: Parameterize with parameter placeholders ($1) with a bound list so input stays data; never interpolate values into SQL text.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any concatenated query matches, including trusted assembly. Input trust needs human review.

tests.line: Repo.query!("SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = '" <> name <> "'")
# audit: Repo.query!("SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = '" <> name <> "'") present
# verified: Repo.query!("SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = $1", [name])
